crossRefs.note: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss…
Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add…
For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven…
and having a great priest over God’s house,

translations.web: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,
translations.bsb: Then the sixth angel sounded his trumpet, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar before God
translations.kjv: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the four horns of the golden altar which is before God,
translations.asv: And the sixth angel sounded, and I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,
